summary: Add resumable unified baseline snapshot creation and publishing
details: The existing snapshot script supports baseline create, finalize and publish with existing snapshot keys and object storage, using stopped exact-height databases, managed full or AssumeUTXO replay, or authenticated legacy core and registry pairs.

Export rows and cursors commit atomically. Completed batches survive process interruption; incomplete verification scans restart. Publication reuses matching uploaded objects and checks full public contents before publishing its immutable record. Installation and node orchestration remain separate stages.
